steps.code:
# The query returned 20 results, but there may be more pages. Let's fetch all pages to ensure we capture all electricity transactions.
all_transactions = []
page_index = 0
while True:
    page = apis.venmo.show_transactions(access_token=access_token, query='electricity', direction='sent', min_created_at='2023-01-01', max_created_at='2023-05-18', page_limit=20, page_index=page_index)
    if not page:
        break
    all_transactions.extend(page)
    if len(page) < 20:
        break
    page_index += 1

# Filter only transactions with description containing "electricity" (case-insensitive)
electricity_transactions = [t for t in all_transactions if 'electricity' in t['description'].lower()]
print(electricity_transactions)
